items.exampleEn: Nobody recognized him in his clever disguise.
items.exampleZh: 他喬裝得很巧妙，沒有人認出他來。

items.exampleEn: The children's imitation of bird songs was surprisingly good.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們模仿鳥叫聲模仿得出奇地好。

items.exampleEn: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
items.exampleZh: 動物園管理員每天早上餵獅子。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant on top of the tower slowly revolves.
items.exampleZh: 塔頂上的餐廳會慢慢旋轉。

items.exampleEn: We felt the vibration of the trains passing under the building.
items.exampleZh: 我們感覺得到火車從大樓底下經過時的震動。

items.exampleEn: Her persistence finally paid off when she got the job.
items.exampleZh: 她得到那份工作時，堅持終於有了回報。

items.exampleEn: The old bridge needs reinforcement before heavy trucks can use it.
items.exampleZh: 那座舊橋需要補強，重型卡車才能通行。

items.exampleEn: Reading is a pleasant diversion on long train trips.
items.exampleZh: 閱讀是長途火車旅行中愉快的消遣。
items.glossZh: 消遣；轉移注意的事；繞道（英式）

items.sentenceEn: The Earth revolves around the sun once a year.
items.sentenceZh: 地球每年繞太陽轉一圈。

items.audioEn: There's a diversion on the main road today, so the bus will take about twenty minutes longer.
items.audioZh: 今天主要道路要繞道，所以公車會多花大約二十分鐘。
options: Not run at all this morning

items.sentenceEn: I could feel the vibration of the music through the floor.
items.sentenceZh: 我能透過地板感受到音樂的震動。

items.sentenceEn: Ask the park keeper if you lose anything here.
items.sentenceZh: 如果在這裡掉了東西，就去問公園管理員。

items.stemEn: This isn't real leather; it's a cheap ____.
items.stemZh: 這不是真皮，是便宜的仿製品。

items.stemEn: With great ____, she practiced every day until she could play the song perfectly.
items.stemZh: 她以極大的毅力每天練習，直到能完美彈奏那首曲子。

items.passageEn: Our town's soccer team had a strange match last Sunday against a strong opponent. In the first half, a dog ran onto the field, which created a funny diversion and stopped the game for ten minutes. Our keeper, who is only seventeen, saved three hard shots. In the second half, the coach brought in reinforcements from the bench, and the team played with great persistence. They finally won by one goal, and the cheering was so loud that I could feel the vibration in my seat.
items.passageZh: 上週日，我們鎮上的足球隊和一支強隊踢了一場奇特的比賽。上半場有一隻狗跑進場，引起一陣好笑的騷動，比賽因此停了十分鐘。我們只有十七歲的守門員擋下了三記強勁的射門。下半場，教練從板凳派上生力軍，球隊以極大的毅力奮戰。他們最後贏了一球，歡呼聲大到我能感覺到座位在震動。

questions.questionZh: 上半場比賽為什麼停了十分鐘？

items.promptZh: 她講電話時故意改變了自己的聲音。
referenceEn: She disguised her voice on the phone.
She disguised her voice when she was talking on the phone.
rubricZh: 要用 disguise 當動詞（例如 disguised her voice）
「講電話時」可寫，例如 on the phone、when she was talking on the phone 等
時態合理即可（例如 disguised、disguises 等）

items.promptZh: 我妹妹很會模仿我們的老師。
referenceEn: My younger sister does a great imitation of our teacher.
My little sister is very good at doing imitations of our teacher.
rubricZh: imitation 當名詞（例如 does a great imitation of、is good at doing imitations of 等）
「很會」可寫，例如 does a great…、is very good at… 等
「妹妹」可寫，例如 younger sister、little sister 等
